blind.description: A stylized two-story wooden animal hutch or rabbit coop. It features two tiers, each divided into an open section with vertical bars showing straw/hay bedding inside and an enclosed nesting area with a small round doorway and latch. A slanted wooden ramp/ladder is attached to the right side leading up to the second level. The unit has a sloped dark grey-green wooden plank roof with raised end trims and stands firmly on four corner legs.
blind.from_above: A rectangular sloped roof with dark wood/slate-green planks framed by raised wooden edges, with an open gap along the peak/back and a small ladder extending out on the right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4.0 feet tall (approximately two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 feet wide including the side ladder.
